import { TABLES, find, update } from '@/lib/store';
import { ApiError, errorResponse } from '@/lib/errors';

export async function POST(request: Request, { params }: { params: { run_id: string } }) {
  let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return errorResponse(new ApiError('validation_failed', 'Request body must be valid JSON'));
  }

  const participant_name = typeof body.participant_name === 'string' ? body.participant_name.trim() : '';

  if (!participant_name) {
    return errorResponse(
      new ApiError('validation_failed', 'participant_name is required and must not be empty')
    );
  }

  const run = find(TABLES.Run, params.run_id);
  if (!run) {
    return errorResponse(new ApiError('run_not_found', `Run '${params.run_id}' not found`));
  }

  const existingNames: string[] = Array.isArray(run.participant_names) ? run.participant_names : [];

  const isDuplicate = existingNames.some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === participant_name.toLowerCase());
  if (isDuplicate) {
    return errorResponse(
      new ApiError('duplicate_participant', `Participant '${participant_name}' is already on this run`)
    );
  }

  const updatedRun = {
    ...run,
    participant_names: [...existingNames, participant_name],
  };

  const result = update(TABLES.Run, updatedRun);
  return Response.json(result);
}
